title: Standing Points Reduction in Dropped-Batch Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the violation points a shopper already carries reduce what a dropped-batch dispute can give back.

**Clause.** The drop standing reduction looks at the account's other standing violation points, meaning the points of every recorded violation less the points of every cleared entry, the disputed violation's own recorded points left out: 6 or more take off 2 points; from 3 up to 5 (one fewer than 6) take off 1 point; fewer take off nothing.

**The figure.** The total points of all violation entries recorded on the account, less the total points of all cleared entries on the account (whatever their removal reason), less the recorded points of the dropped-batch violation under dispute.

| Other standing violation points | Drop standing reduction |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 points |
| 3 to 5 | 1 point |
| 0 to 2 | Nothing |

## Worked example (hypothetical account)

Recorded violations total 12 points, including the disputed dropped-batch violation of 3 points; cleared entries total 4 points. Other standing points: 12 less 4 less 3, that is 5 — a reduction of 1 point. If a further cleared entry of 3 points were on the account, the figure would be 2 and the reduction nothing.
